fusions.name: Web Burst
fusions.desc: Silk bursts out, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Plucked Line
fusions.desc: Snaps a taut strand that deals 8 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Every creature within 4 tiles is held in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spun Thread
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (162% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
